status: frozen draft; fixture bytes, DGPs, seed convention, estimands, and gates are fixed; no fitting or recovery campaign run

implementation_readiness.fit_api: available in both products from M1 (Julia cjs; R drm_cjs)
implementation_readiness.simulation_api: M2 predict/simulate/inference method definitions are present in the current shared working trees, but remain uncommitted concurrent work and were not verified in this fixture slice
implementation_readiness.smoke_state: literal generated datasets are ready; no fitting or public-API generation call was run because this slice is restricted to light parsing and fixture-integrity checks

generator.ordering: for each individual, draw masked-survey indicators in increasing post-capture occasion order; then draw interval survival and, when alive and surveyed, detection in increasing interval order
generator.conditioning: first capture occasion is fixed in advance and its emission is conditioned upon; simulation starts alive immediately after that capture
generator.administrative_followup: simulate through each individual's declared administrative endpoint; do not truncate at last capture
generator.masking: each post-capture survey is independently observed with probability 0.92; an unobserved survey is stored as capture blank and observed=0, while latent survival still advances
generator.death: absorbing; once dead, no later captures occur
generator.frequency: one per literal individual; no frequency expansion in this fixture
generator.units: years; interval lengths are already in years

common_design.first_capture: occasion 5 for ids with i mod 11 = 0; otherwise occasion 1 for odd i and occasion 2 for even i
common_design.administrative_end: occasion 4 when i mod 7 = 0 and first_capture < 5; otherwise occasion 5
common_design.x_phi: -0.5 for odd i, +0.5 for even i
common_design.final_first_histories: retained; likelihood contribution is one and they do not inform coefficients

cells.role: fixed-effects recovery smoke for phi coefficients
fixed-effects recovery smoke for p coefficients

denominators.fit_attempts: every attempted fit, including errors, nonconvergence, boundary, singular-Hessian, and failed fits
denominators.usable_point_estimates: converged fit with finite component-labelled coefficients and finite gradient; report count over all attempted fits
denominators.wald_available: usable fit plus finite positive-definite observed Hessian and no fitted-probability boundary flag; denominator is all attempted fits
denominators.coverage: covered usable intervals divided by usable intervals; also report covered usable intervals divided by all attempts
denominators.no_replacement: never replace a failed attempt or extend a seed range after inspecting outcomes

smoke_acceptance_when_api_ready.purpose: mechanism and pipeline smoke only; not empirical recovery qualification or calibration
data_integrity: regeneration reproduces all three fixture CSV files byte-for-byte
same fixture hashes and row counts in Julia and R worktrees
each history has exactly one observed first capture; no capture follows admin_end
all masked captures are blank with observed=0; latent generator advances across masked occasions
final-first histories remain and contribute likelihood one
fit_diagnostics: fit status and failure reason are retained for every dataset
successful fits have finite labelled estimates, finite objective and gradient norm <= 1e-4
Wald intervals are reported only when Hessian is finite positive definite and probabilities are not boundary flagged
smoke_acceptance_when_api_ready.statistical_boundary: No coefficient-distance or coverage pass/fail claim is made from two datasets per cell. Any coefficient error greater than 0.75 is a diagnostic stop-and-investigate trigger, not an acceptance threshold or evidence of recovery.

pilot.gate: estimate runtime and partition failures before any larger stage

screen.gate: separate parent review after pilot; not authorized by this manifest

qualification.gate: separate approval after screen; not authorized by this manifest

later_recovery_gates_not_run.point_recovery: report bias and RMSE for each named coefficient and response-scale estimand, with Monte Carlo uncertainty; never pool phi and p
later_recovery_gates_not_run.bias: absolute bias <= 0.02 on probability estimands, with its 95% Monte Carlo interval fully inside [-0.02, 0.02]; coefficient-scale bias reported separately and no threshold claimed until parent review
later_recovery_gates_not_run.nominal_95_coverage: two-sided Monte Carlo interval must lie within [0.925, 0.975]; exact coverage 1.000 is a simulator audit trigger, not a pass

seed_ranges.purpose: disjoint deterministic streams; generated datasets must be retained as literal inputs for both products

runtime_and_compute.current_fit_estimate: not applicable: this slice ran no fits; the assigned validation boundary was limited to parsing and fixture integrity
runtime_and_compute.future_pilot_estimate: before any fit, estimate one tiny fit per product at <1 minute each based on M1 smoke evidence; then measure the 10-fit pilot. If the projected pilot exceeds 3 hours, provide pre-run test evidence and obtain approval before proceeding.
runtime_and_compute.campaigns: no 500- or 2000-replicate campaign has run or is authorized; campaigns must not use GitHub Actions

calibration_status: pending; no calibration or coverage claim
